title: Audio Converter (MP3 AAC OPUS)
summary: Convert audio and video to MP3 — cut audio clips, fast batch convert offline
description:
Audio Converter, Convert, Cut & Extract Audio

Audio Converter is a simple and reliable Android app that helps you convert audio formats, cut audio clips, extract sound from videos, and convert multiple files at once, all directly on your device.

Whether you want to convert music to MP3, cut a ringtone, set an alarm sound, or extract audio from a video, Audio Converter helps you get it done in just a few taps.

Convert Audio in Seconds

Select one or multiple files, choose the output format and quality, and tap Convert.

Audio Converter supports batch conversion, allowing you to convert multiple audio files at once. This makes it ideal for playlists or large audio collections.

Available quality options range from 8 kb/s to 320 kb/s, so you can easily balance file size and sound quality.

No account required. No complicated setup.

Supported Audio Formats

Convert audio files to popular formats such as:

MP3, AAC, M4A, OGG, OPUS, WAV, FLAC, WMA, AMR (NB & WB), AC3, and more.

You can also convert less-supported formats, such as OPUS or WMA, into formats commonly supported on Android devices.

Extract Audio from Video

Easily extract audio from video files and save it as an audio file for listening, sharing, or further editing.

Media access is used only to let you select audio or video files for conversion.

Audio Editing & Customization

Customize your audio before converting:

• Cut audio before or after conversion  
• Adjust bitrate, sample rate, and channels  
• Support for CBR, VBR, and ABR  
• Change playback speed  
• Increase volume before conversion  
• Add or replace MP3 cover art  
• Edit audio tags such as Title, Artist, and Album

Audio Cutter, Ringtone & Alarm Maker

Cut precise audio clips and save them as:

• Music  
• Ringtone  
• Alarm sound  
• Notification sound  

You can also:

• Set clips as your default ringtone  
• Set clips as your default alarm sound  
• Set clips as your default notification sound

Share & Export

• Share converted files via messaging and social apps  
• Upload files to Google Drive, Dropbox, or SoundCloud  
• Keep your audio files organized on your device

Why Choose Audio Converter

• Convert single files or multiple files at once (batch mode)  
• Works fully offline  
• No account or sign-up required  
• Clear and user-friendly interface  
• Designed for everyday use, no technical skills needed

Audio Converter helps you manage, cut, and convert your audio files with confidence.
